The Problem: Vision Agents are Too Expensive & RPA is Too Brittle We hit a massive wall with current GUI automation. Traditional RPA (AppleScript, rigid X/Y coordinate clickers) breaks the moment you resize a window or an app updates its UI. content: ModelHub | The missing menu bar app for local LLMs on Mac. | Product Hunt Launching today ModelHub Launching today The missing menu bar app for local LLMs on Mac. 487 followers The missing menu bar app for local LLMs on Mac. 487 followers Visit website LLM Developer Tools ModelHub is a native macOS menu bar app for developers working with local LLMs. It helps you discover models from Hugging Face, download the right local build, manage your model library, and use Hugging Face models with Ollama, MLX, LM Studio, llama.cpp, and the tools you already have without bouncing between browser tabs, terminal commands, model cards, and local folders. Ollama, MLX, and LM Studio are great tools. ModelHub is the missing discovery and management layer around them. Ollama makes running local models simple. MLX makes Apple Silicon a stronger platform for inference. LM Studio gives people a great local model workspace. Hugging Face has the model ecosystem. But as developers, we kept running into the same problem: Finding the right model, checking the right format, downloading it, remembering what was installed, switching between Ollama, MLX, LM Studio, Hugging Face, and local folders, and keeping everything organized still involved too many tabs, terminal commands, and disconnected tools. So we built ModelHub: a native macOS menu bar app for discovering, downloading, and managing local LLMs from Hugging Face, then using them with Ollama, MLX, LM Studio, llama.cpp, and the tools you already use. content: Runway Agent | Generate edited, sound-designed videos via chat | Product Hunt Launching today Runway Agent Launching today Generate edited, sound-designed videos via chat 184 followers Generate edited, sound-designed videos via chat 184 followers Visit website Video editing • AI Video Editor Runway Agent is a conversational AI that takes a brief and outputs finished, sound-designed, edited videos for ads, shorts, and social content. Available in the Runway web app. Overview Reviews Alternatives Team More Free Options Launch tags: Design Tools • Social Media • Marketing Launch Team Show more Show more Launching Today # 6 Day Rank Upvote • 154 points Follow Runway Agent Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info app.runwayml.com/agent Runway Agent Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/runway-agent Similar Products Tines Build agents & automations integrated across your workspace Try Tines Promoted Jupitrr AI Your all-in-one video workflow tool 4.8 ( 37 reviews ) Video editing Content Management Systems Descript If you can edit text, you can make videos, podcast, & clips 4.4 ( 41 reviews ) Augie Studio Making video creation accessible and intuitive for everyone 4.8 ( 24 reviews ) Video editing Marketing & Sales VidAU All-in-One AI Video Ad Solution for Performance Marketing 4.5 ( 24 reviews ) Design & Creative Marketing & Sales RunwayML Create impossible video 4.3 ( 17 reviews ) Video editing AI Generative Media View more Subscribe Sign in Social X AppSignal — Get full visibility into app health, errors, and performance Get full visibility into app health, errors, and performance Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Rohan Chaubey Hunter 📌 Runway Agent is a chat-based AI inside the Runway web app that handles ideation, editing, sound design, and final output as a single conversation. You describe what you need, the agent builds toward it, and the output is a complete, publish-ready file rather than raw footage requiring further work. What makes it different : Most AI video tools are prompt-in, clip-out. Runway Agent operates at the project level, covering generation, editing, and audio in one session. The "finished" framing in Runway's own copy is the operative word here. The output includes sound design, not just visuals. Key features : Conversational interface for creative direction and execution Full video output with editing and sound design included Targets ads, shorts, and social content formats Available on Runway web Who it's for : Content teams, solo creators, and marketers producing short-form video for social, ads, or branded content who want to go from idea to finished output without context-switching between tools. An agent that can hold a creative brief and execute it end-to-end is a different product category from a generation tool. Whether the execution holds up in practice will be the real test, but the direction is the right one. P.S.
